mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id, display_name, base_url, endpoint_path, main_model, light_model, api_key, updated_at FROM diet_model_config WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_model_config ( id, provider_id, display_name, base_url, endpoint_path, main_model, light_model, api_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{providerId}, #{displayName}, #{baseUrl}, #{endpointPath}, #{mainModel}, #{lightModel}, #{apiKey}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider_id = VALUES(provider_id), display_name = VALUES(display_name), base_url = VALUES(base_url), endpoint_path = VALUES(endpoint_path), main_model = VALUES(main_model), light_model = VALUES(light_model), api_key = VALUES(api_key), updated_at = NOW()
